package.name: global_path_planner_cpp
package.description: Global path planner for the BFMC autonomy stack. Loads the competition GraphML map at startup (tinyxml2), builds an adjacency-list graph, and serves a Dijkstra / A* path from the vehicle's nearest node to a configurable goal node. Publishes nav_msgs/Path on /planning/global_path plus a small bundle of /planning/debug/* diagnostics. Replans on significant deviation (>0.4 m default) from the active path. Pure C++; no GPU dependency; no modification to bfmc_msgs.
